services.name: New 24' Premier Sweetwater Pontoon
services.desc: A Unique Boating Experience on the St. Lawrence River ​Our top-of-the-line 24-foot Sweetwater by Godfrey pontoons are the perfect way to experience the river. ​ With 115hp engines, spacious layouts, and a bimini top for shade, they're built for comfort, fun, and easy cruising. ​ Whether you're looking to explore hidden coves, picnic by a historic castle, or simply soak up the sun with family and friends, Wagoner Pontoons provides the perfect vessel for making lasting memories!
